explication: SideInstaller is an on-device iOS app that pairs with a device, authenticates an Apple account, obtains and signs app packages, then installs SideStore and optionally LiveContainer. The main runtime path is coordinated by Engine; pairing, device communication, downloading, signing, and installation are distinct stages. The app also handles certificate management, custom IPA deep links, and pairing status activities. Edges use README claims and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled implementation details are represented only where paths and relationships are supported.
